Most went up overnight (with thanks to W.R.L.) and savoured the delights of Stoke on a Saturday night and despite the "Cuff" strip tease before the match, everything went very well on the day and we easily qualified for the final by finishing second to Wolverhampton & Bilston 139-137 pts.
